# Eclectik

> Boutique AI-transformation consultancy that operationalizes Workplace Signals end-to-end — combining objective telemetry with subjective sentiment to build actionable roadmaps that deliver measurable business impact.

Eclectik helps enterprises move from "what if we adopt AI?" to "we can — here is the ROI, here is the rollout, and here is how we measure impact." We connect collaboration data, Microsoft Copilot usage, and Viva engagement signals to business outcomes, then activate the change through training, executive coaching, and packaged Microsoft licenses with service-level commitments. ISO 27001 certified.

Trusted partners include Alex Lee, EFTA, IMC, Almirall, TD Industries, Warburtons, Westfalen, Breitling, and Pepkor.

## Services

- [Consulting](https://www.eclectik.co/consulting): Operationalize Workplace Signals. We combine objective telemetry with subjective signals to build actionable AI-transformation roadmaps that deliver measurable impact.
- [Training](https://www.eclectik.co/training): Interpretation and change activation. We upskill leaders, managers, and HR teams to interpret signals confidently and activate change consistently.
- [Solutions](https://www.eclectik.co/solutions): Licenses and packaged offerings. Eclectik bundles Microsoft Viva and Copilot licenses with onboarding, analytics accelerators, and service-level commitments.
- [HR Tech Services](https://www.eclectik.co/hrtechservices): Independent Customer Success and People Science for organisations on Viva Glint or Workvivo Seer.
- [Glint Support](https://www.eclectik.co/glint-support): Independent Customer Success and People Science for organisations running Viva Glint: cycle design, manager enablement and turning results into movement.

## Case studies

- [Copilot ROI Impact](https://www.eclectik.co/case-studies/copilot-impact): Modeling AI value with real collaboration telemetry and Copilot usage to predict ROI/TCO and guide rollout.
- [Copilot Adoption](https://www.eclectik.co/case-studies/copilot-adoption): Driving sustained Microsoft Copilot adoption at enterprise scale.
- [Glint & Insights](https://www.eclectik.co/case-studies/glint-insights): Connecting engagement sentiment to observable behavior changes — cycle time, rework, focus time.
- [AKKODiS Power Platform](https://www.eclectik.co/case-studies/akkodis-power-platform): Power Platform transformation case.
- [Microsoft Viva Transformation](https://www.eclectik.co/case-studies/microsoft-viva-transformation): End-to-end Microsoft Viva implementation and adoption.
